none: PAS CAM-0E4567: Roman Coin: Copper-alloy numus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy numus of the House of Valentinian. Mint is uncertain but coin is in style of Arles, AD 364-378, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. Reverse shows Victory with wreath advancing left (style of Arles). Obverse legend is illegible. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed bust right. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 1.66g, diameter is 17.74mm
